summary: WebSocket streaming becomes silent mid-handshake after worker rollback during KV sync
description: Issue summary: Multiple customer WebSocket streaming sessions (NoteAI, dedicated tenant) go silent during connection establishment. The TCP connection remains open and client sees no SSE/WebSocket messages after initial HTTP 101 upgrade; sessions eventually timeout on client side (30s) and are marked failed. Impact: real-time chat for NoteAI degraded for ~5% of long-conversation requests; high business impact for this dedicated customer under steady load. Environment: prod-us-west with dedicated GPU pool. Observed timing correlation with background KV cache checkpoint/consistency repair on workers and short-lived scheduler-driven worker rollbacks.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use NoteAI tenant credentials and open a WebSocket connection to wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?tenant=noteai
2) Send a chat start message with ~12k tokens of context and request streaming (expect progressive tokens),
3) Repeat under steady throughput (~120 concurrent streams) for 10+ minutes to reproduce race window
4) Observe that some connections complete the HTTP 101 upgrade and accept client frames but then stop receiving server stream frames (no further messages) until client timeout.

observed_behavior: Connections complete upgrade but server stops emitting streamed tokens mid-generation without explicit connection close. TCP and WS handshake stay open; probes show no application frames for long periods. The issue often coincides with worker rollback events and KV sync activity.
expected_behavior: After HTTP 101 upgrade, server should stream tokens progressively until generation finishes or an explicit error occurs. Handshake/upgrade should not be interrupted by background worker reorgs.
investigation_notes: Initial triage (Support): customer provided pcap + SDK logs showing 101 upgrade then silence for 21s before client timed out.
SRE reproduced locally using fixture workload targeting dedicated pool and observed silent gaps when checkpointing overlapped with handshake completion.
Examined scheduler logs: preemptive_rebalance triggered on nodes with heavy KV checkpoint activity; scheduler signaled rollback to workers during in-flight handshakes.

Serving runtime trace: handshake coroutine remains registered to connection but internal generation loop is paused due to worker entering 'consistency_repair' path which temporarily takes the generation lock for KV checkpointing; after rollback, coroutine is not resumed promptly (deadlock on per-request token dispatcher).
Edge-proxy analysis: TCP connection not reset; no 5xx returned; upstream shows unacknowledged application-level frames.

Hypothesis: a race between KV checkpoint/consistency repair and handshake completion causes the worker to enter a rollback/eviction flow that leaves the handshake state in an inconsistent 'pinned but stalled' state, preventing outbound token emission while the connection remains open.
comments: Support (Aisha Patel) 2026-03-10: Customer first reported silent streams at 15:20 UTC; provided sample request IDs and SDK pcap. Marked as P1 due to dedicated tenant impact.
SRE (Jordan Kim) 2026-03-10: Reproduced with dedicated-pool stress test. Observed worker rollback correlated with KV checkpoint. Adding scheduler and worker traces to ticket.

Eng (Miguel Torres) 2026-03-11: Confirmed coroutine stall inside generation dispatcher when rollback occurs mid-handshake. Preparing patch to avoid evicting handshake-owning worker until handshake finalization.
Customer (NoteAI technical lead - Sara Myers) 2026-03-11: Confirmed incident observed in production; urgent fix appreciated. Customer requested ETA and temporary mitigation.

Support (Aisha Patel) 2026-03-11: Provided customer with recommended temporary change: reduce background KV checkpoint frequency for their dedicated pool (configurable) and increase client-side streaming idle timeout to 60s as short-term mitigation.
suggested_workaround: 1) Short term: disable aggressive KV checkpointing on NoteAI's dedicated pool (config flag: kv.checkpoint.interval -> 60s) and request client increase websocket idle timeout to 60s. 2) Mid term: deploy a scheduler flag to avoid evicting workers with active handshakes until handshake completion ACK is committed.
resolution: In progress - temporary mitigation applied (kv.checkpoint.interval increased for NoteAI). Engineering PR open to change eviction logic and handshake pin semantics.
resolution_notes: Temporary mitigation rolled out to NoteAI's dedicated pool on 2026-03-11 03:00 UTC; support observed immediate reduction in silent streams from ~5% -> ~0.2% under test. Full fix requires runtime change to avoid handshake rollback; PR created (see related_github_prs).
next_steps: Merge PR that adjusts eviction policy to respect active handshake state and add unit/integration tests (owner: Miguel Torres).
Add an alert that triggers when post-upgrade idle >10s for streaming connections to catch regressions earlier.
Schedule a customer follow-up call with NoteAI to confirm restored SLA behavior and update runbook.
